info.title: Rampsmith API
info.description: Control-plane API behind the Rampsmith web app. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json.

get.summary:
Liveness: answers as long as the process runs. Never touches dependencies, so a slow
database cannot get a healthy process restarted.
Readiness: the database answers and holds at least this build's newest migration.

post.summary: Completes a registration and signs the new user in.
Starts registering an account and its first passkey.

get.summary: The signed-in user; also extends the session's idle expiry.

delete.summary: Signs out: the session token stops working.

post.summary: Starts a passkey sign-in. No email: the browser offers the passkeys it holds for this site.
Starts a free scan of one public website, or returns the answer already held for it.

200.description: A scan of this domain from the last 24 hours answers

202.description: The scan is queued or running

422.description: The address or the challenge was refused

503.description: The scanner is busy or not configured

get.summary:
A free scan's state and result. The id is unguessable and the scan holds nothing about the
visitor; it is gone 24 hours after it was asked for.

404.description: No such scan, or it expired

get.summary: A screenshot taken before or after a fix.
Open findings, ranked by priority score.

parameters.name: criterion
parameters.description: A WCAG success criterion such as `1.1.1`.

parameters.name: has_fix
parameters.description: Only findings that have (true) or lack (false) a fix.

422.description: A filter or the cursor is invalid

get.summary: One finding with its occurrences, evidence and fixes.
Fixes: the review queue, or what was applied.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description:
`queue` (default): waiting, approved, applying or failed. `applied`: applied or verified.
`all`.

422.description: A filter or the cursor is invalid

put.summary: Edits the alt text of a fix that is waiting for review.

409.description: The fix is no longer waiting for review

422.description: The alt text is empty or too long

post.summary: Approves a fix: Rampsmith then changes the alt text in the shop.

parameters.name: confirm_flagged
parameters.description:
Must be true to approve a draft flagged `instruction_like_text_seen` or
`suspected_prompt_injection`; ignored for an unflagged draft.

200.description: The approved fix; it is applied shortly

403.description: The plan does not cover another image fix

422.description: The draft was flagged for review and `confirm_flagged` is not true

post.summary: Rejects a fix that is waiting for review; nothing changes in the shop.
Undoes an applied fix: Rampsmith puts the earlier alt text back if nobody changed it since.

202.description: The undo is queued; the fix reads reverted when done

409.description: The fix is not applied, or an undo is already running

get.summary: The pass rate, open findings by impact, fixes awaiting approval, and the last and next scan.

post.summary: Starts a scan of the shop.

403.description: The shop has not chosen a plan yet

429.description: The plan's manual scans for the last 24 hours are used

get.summary: One scan, with its progress and coverage.

post.summary:
Starts an embedded-app session: verifies the Shopify session token and, on first use,
installs the app by token exchange.

401.description: Missing, invalid or stale session token; the response carries `X-Shopify-Retry-Invalid-Session-Request: 1`

502.description: Shopify did not answer token exchange

put.summary: Changes the shop's settings. Fields left out stay as they are.

403.description: The plan does not include weekly rescans

503.description: Saving a password is not configured

get.summary: The accessibility statement: the open draft and the saved versions.

put.summary: Saves the statement as the draft.

flags.description:
Why the draft needs a closer look before it is approved: `instruction_like_text_seen`
(the model said the image or the store data held instructions) or
`suspected_prompt_injection` (the product title or type read like instructions). A flagged
draft is approved only with `confirm_flagged` (ADR-213).

CeremonyResponse.description: Completes a ceremony with the browser's answer.

CeremonyStarted.description: Options for `navigator.credentials`, and the ceremony they belong to.

ceremony_id.description: Echo this in the matching `finish` call.

options.description: WebAuthn options in their JSON form (`publicKey` and, for sign-in, `mediation`).

automated.description: WCAG success criteria the automated checks tested.

review_queue.description: Findings waiting for a person's review.

CreateFreeScan.description: A request for a free scan, from the web server.

client_ip.description: The visitor's address, as the web server saw it.

renews_at.description: When the window renews; null on Free.

used.description: Drafts used in the current window (the shop's lifetime on Free).

unlocked_by.description: The lowest plan that unlocks it, when it is locked.

FieldError.description: One invalid field of a request.

field.description: JSON path of the field, such as `shop` or `items.0.alt`.

message.description: What is wrong, safe to show to the user.

templates.description: The page types the finding appears on.

oneOf.description: The newest fix for this finding, if any.

title.description: One plain-language sentence naming the problem.

approver_name.description: Shopify does not give the app the staff member's name.

product_title.description: The product the image belongs to.

FreeScanDto.description: A free scan and, once finished, what it found.

cached.description: True when an earlier scan of this domain answered the request.

refusal.description: Why a refused scan was refused: `robots`, `bot-challenge` or `unreachable`.

FreeScanExample.description: One example of a failure: a page and the offending element's markup.

page.description: The page the element is on.

snippet.description: The element's markup, scrubbed and cut to a few hundred characters.

FreeScanFailure.description: One kind of failure on the scanned pages, with up to three examples.

count.description: How many elements failed across the scanned pages.

criterion.description: The WCAG 2.2 success criterion, such as `1.4.3`.

title.description: What the failure is, in plain words.

FreeScanResult.description: What a free scan found (PLAN §16): checks passed of checks run, and the failures by type.

domain.description: The scanned domain, without a leading `www.`.

pages.description: The pages checked: the home page and up to two linked pages.

html_excerpt.description: A scrubbed HTML excerpt of at most 512 characters.

first_fix_at.description: When the first fix was applied.

next_scan_at.description: When the next scheduled rescan runs, when weekly rescans are on.

open_by_impact.description: Open findings by impact; best practices are not counted.

Problem.description:
An RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` body with Rampsmith's extension members.

Unknown members are ignored on input, as RFC 9457 requires of consumers.

detail.description: Explanation specific to this occurrence. Never contains tokens or personal data.

title.description: Short summary of the problem type.

trace_id.description: W3C trace id of the request, for support.

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type: `/problems/<code>`.

ProblemCode.description:
Stable, enumerated error code. Clients branch on this, never on `title` or `detail`.

Adding a code is a contract change; renaming or removing one is a breaking change.

Readiness.description: The process can serve: the database answers and has this build's migrations.

expected_schema_version.description: The newest migration this build knows.

schema_version.description: The newest migration applied to the database.

display_name.description: The name to show in the dashboard.

oneOf.description: The coverage disclosure; null until the scan is finalised.

error_code.description: A short code such as `store_unreachable`; never store content.

ruleset_version.description: The axe-core version the scan ran with.

SessionCreated.description: A new session. The token is shown once; store it in an `HttpOnly` cookie.

expires_at.description: When the session ends regardless of use.

ai_budget_max_micro_usd.description: The plan's ceiling for the budget.

SettingsUpdateBody.description: Fields left out stay as they are; `storefront_password: null` clears the saved password.

name.description: The shop's name, once `shopify.read_store` has read it; null before the first scan.

oneOf.description: The open draft, if there is one.

UserInfo.description: A dashboard user, as the web app shows them.

dashboard_session.name: Authorization
dashboard_session.description: `Session <token>`: the dashboard session token, forwarded by the web app (ADR-024).

free_scan_service.description: `FREE_SCAN_SERVICE_TOKEN`: the secret the web server presents for the free scanner (ADR-267).

shopify_session.description: The App Bridge session (ID) token, forwarded by the web app (ADR-022).
